recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source edit is needed unless the work group later revisits decimal implicit precision semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-17668 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Search and requested explicit text that decimal searches involve an implicit range whose significant digits are the digits in the search parameter value excluding leading zeros, so 100 and 1.00e2 both have three significant digits.
initial_application: Commit 7f7f00d8e9fbee429ee41d10f4c2332de814516a, "GF#17668 - note about decimal range", added the requested note to source/search.html. The note was preserved through later Search page restructuring.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists source/search.html as the active Search page under RESTful API. Later Published issue FHIR-26311 intentionally narrowed the first sentence so implicit decimal ranges apply when comparison prefixes are not used. FHIR-30096 and the related Zulip Significant figures thread support the current significant-figure examples and do not reverse the seed rule. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting FHIR-17668-specific community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/search.html already states the requested rule at the current number-search section: decimals without the comparison prefixes involve an implicit range, significant digits exclude leading zeros, and 100 and 1.00e2 both have three significant digits.
